title: Integral lattice cubical chain groups and explicit maps
statement: For $r\in\mathbf N$ and $a\in\mathbf Z$, let $\mathcal I_{r,a}$ be the set of finite subsets $I\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}(r)$ with $|I|=a$, and let $C_a$ be the free abelian group [def-weil-pbc-free-module] on pairs $(v,I)$ with $v\in\mathbf Z^r$ and $I\in\mathcal I_{r,a}$. For arbitrary $I$, define $[v,I]=0$ when $|I|\ne a$. Let $u_i$ be the standard lattice vector. Define $\partial_a:C_a\to C_{a-1}$ by $\partial_a[v,I]=\sum_{i\in I}(-1)^{|\{j\in I:j<i\}|}([v+u_i,I\setminus\{i\}]-[v,I\setminus\{i\}])$, extended by finite integer linear combinations. The incoming boundary $C_{a+1}\to C_a$ is $\partial_{a+1}$ with the canonical degree identification. Define $\epsilon:C_0\to\mathbf Z$ by $\epsilon[v,I]=1$, $s:\mathbf Z\to C_0$ by $s(1)=[0,\varnothing]$, $e_a:C_a\to C_a$ by $e_a[v,I]=[0,\varnothing]$ (hence zero if $a\ne0$), and $\tau_{w,a}:C_a\to C_a$ by $\tau_{w,a}[v,I]=[v+w,I]$. Each formula extends linearly.
